مَنْشُورٌ What is not sealed, [here meaning not closed with a seal,] of the writings of the Sultán [or of a viceroy]; (K;) i. e., what is now commonly known by the name of فَرْمَان: pl. مَنَاشِيرُ. (TA.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) A man whose state of affairs is disorganised, or disordered. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
